# WackyTracky

> WackyTracky is a minimal, keyboard-friendly, self-hosted task and list tracker. It exposes a Connect RPC API (HTTP + JSON): every procedure is a `POST` with a JSON body to `/api/wackytracky.clientapi.v1.WackyTrackyClientService/<Method>`. The default backend stores tasks in plain-text [todo.txt](http://todotxt.org) format.

To call the API: send `POST` requests with `Content-Type: application/json`. Empty requests use the body `{}`. JSON field names are camelCase (e.g. `parent_list_id` becomes `parentListId`). On error the server returns a 4xx/5xx status and a Connect error JSON payload.

## API

- [API overview](https://jamesread.github.io/WackyTracky/api/index.html): Base URL, the Connect protocol, authentication, and copy-paste `curl` quick-start examples.
- [API reference](https://jamesread.github.io/WackyTracky/api/reference.html): Every RPC with its request/response message and all fields.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://jamesread.github.io/WackyTracky/_attachments/openapi.yaml): Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 description. A running server also serves the same file at `GET /openapi`.
- Running server: `GET /llms.txt` on your WackyTracky instance summarizes the OpenAPI spec, HTTP API, and MCP server for LLM clients.
- [Search syntax](https://jamesread.github.io/WackyTracky/api/search.html): Query syntax for `SearchTasks`.
- [MCP server](https://jamesread.github.io/WackyTracky/api/mcp.html): Connect at `/mcp` (Streamable HTTP) or run `wt mcp` over stdio.

## Source

- [wt.proto](https://github.com/wacky-tracky/WackyTracky/blob/main/protocol/wacky-tracky/clientapi/v1/wt.proto): Protocol Buffers definition — the source of truth for the API.
